name: claude-chat-ferry
description: Move a chat between Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity: continue a Cursor or Antigravity chat in Claude Code, hand a Claude Code session to them, or turn any of them (and claude.ai or ChatGPT exports) into Markdown or JSON.

plugins.name: chat-ferry
plugins.description: Continue this project's latest Cursor or Antigravity chat in Claude Code (/chat-ferry:import), or hand this session to them as a Markdown file with secrets redacted (/chat-ferry:export). The claude-chat-ferry command does the same from a terminal, at no token cost.
